description: Adds one field to a table of the site's connected Supabase project, the same way as Add field in Xodia's Database view (Content, Database): always optional (the table may have entries already), with a migration file in supabase/migrations/ on the branch. Changes the user's live database at once, outside Xodia's Versions. Refused when the table already has that field, for kinds Xodia doesn't add, and for a link to a table with no single ID field. With source "xodia" (or when get_project database.source is "xodia") it works on the site's own Xodia database, whose tables and rules are the file xodia/data-rules.json in the repo: it adds the field to that file and sends it to the test data, like create_table. No tool deletes or renames a table or field, deletes entries, or runs SQL: the owner does that in Xodia's Database view (Content, Database).

branch.description: Optional branch for the migration file; default the branch the workspace has open

kind.description: The kind of field: "text" (Text), "number" (Number), "yes_no" (Yes or no), "date" (Date), "date_time" (Date and time), "link" (Link to another table)

linkTo.description: For kind "link": the table it points at (its single ID field is used)

name.description: The field's name: letters, numbers, spaces and underscores, starting with a letter (it is stored lower case with underscores: "Guest count" becomes guest_count)

source.description: Which database: "xodia" (the site's own Xodia database, kept by Xodia) or "supabase" (the Supabase project the owner connected). Leave out to use the one get_project database.source names

table.description: The table's name as list_tables gives it (bookings)

name: add_field
title: Add a field to a database table
